history.body: Hi, I saw the Pearl Residences ad. I’m looking at a rental property — what makes this location and unit type practical for tenants?

For tenants, the 900 sq. ft. layout has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, which can work well for families or sharers. Seberang Jaya also connects toward Sunway Carnival Mall, Chai Leng Park and the Butterworth urban network. Would you like to come see the layout? Would weekdays or weekends suit you better?
I’m open to considering a viewing, but I’d like to understand the monthly maintenance fees and expected completion timing first. Could you share those details?

The maintenance fee is RM0.18 per sq. ft., inclusive of sinking fund—about RM162/month for the 900 sq. ft. unit. Phase 1 is expected to be completed in Q4 2029. With those details, would you like to start arranging a viewing? Would weekdays or weekends suit you better?
RM162 a month including the sinking fund sounds manageable. Q4 2029 is quite a way off, though. If the viewing is of a show unit, weekends would suit me better. Is that what I’d be seeing?
I don’t have confirmation yet whether the viewing would be of a show unit. I can check that and whether weekend slots are available—shall I confirm both for you?
Yes, please check whether it’s a show unit and if weekend slots are available. Thanks.
Sure—I’ll have the team confirm whether the viewing is of a show unit and what weekend slots are available, then follow up with you.
